preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [a, b, c, d])
preconditions.description: a, b, c, d are non-negative integers
Total count of numbers is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive)

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' if not possible else stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(sequence) == a + b + c + d and all(abs(sequence[i] - sequence[i+1]) == 1 for i in range(len(sequence)-1)) and sequence.count(0) == a and sequence.count(1) == b and sequence.count(2) == c and sequence.count(3) == d
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists, output 'YES' followed by the sequence; otherwise output 'NO'. The sequence must be beautiful (consecutive differences of 1), contain exactly a 0s, b 1s, c 2s, and d 3s, and have length a+b+c+d
